context: May 2024 RS floods; conservative research baseline, not validated operational SOP

status_semantics.suitable: Eligible for human approval for the stated ROLE only; every gate must be verified. Not an autonomous dispatch decision.
status_semantics.caution: Hold for unresolved evidence, mission specialist/site assessment or conservative class restriction; cannot auto-deploy.
status_semantics.unsafe: Exclude this proposed asset/configuration/route for this case; re-evaluate only after facts or resource change.

evaluation.order: Listed order controls first reason at each severity; later rules can only increase severity. Retain all constraints and sources.
evaluation.missing: Missing booleans are unverified, never affirmative. Missing/stale/non-high-confidence depth maps to unknown. Missing depth/extent is potentially wet.
evaluation.boundary: Lower inclusive / upper exclusive except exactly 2.5 m belongs to 1.2-2.5; >2.5 band is strictly greater. Zero depth still requires outside extent and dry surveyed route.
evaluation.depth_overlay: suitable in depth_table means no additional depth-only restriction; all general rules still apply. No numeric maximum is a certified safe limit.
evaluation.source_scope: Rules labelled conservative_policy are derived constraints, not literal source requirements. POLICY is the brief/local design, with no external URL.

input_schema_notes.case: mission: rescue|search|supply (missing conservatively fails drone roles); people_count positive integer; children/infants/elderly/wheelchair/bedridden/pets nonnegative integers; demographics may overlap; location_type house|rooftop|building_upper_floor|public_building|unknown; thermal_required boolean.
input_schema_notes.hazards: depth_m >=0 or null; depth_confidence high|medium|low|unknown; hazards_current boolean attested against event/observation timestamps by caller; inside_flood_extent boolean; extent_date_matches boolean; nearby_road_closure and route_closed boolean; pump_station_outage and post_outage_reassessment boolean; current still|slow|strong|unknown from competent site assessment; debris clear|moderate|heavy|unknown; electricity isolated|suspected_live|live|unknown; overhead_clearance boolean; night boolean; duplicate_check_complete boolean; shelter_distance_m advisory only; route_min_depth_m and route_max_depth_m advisory measurements, not substitutes for clearance attestation.
input_schema_notes.current: No invented universal velocity cutoff. Strong means site assessor identifies swiftwater needing a technical package; unknown stays unknown. FEMA's one-knot descriptor is not the dispatch cutoff.
input_schema_notes.assigned_assets: Per actual asset type: verification flags from documented field/operator assessments, not LLM guesses. True means all relevant limits passed; false means a known failure; absent means unverified. Do not set all flags globally in production.
input_schema_notes.attestation_inputs: route_verified incorporates route_min/max depth, drive clearance, surface strength, obstacles, return and handoff. trip_plan_verified incorporates people including infants, crew, pets, medical equipment, mass, restraint limits and staged multiple trips. weather_released incorporates actual current observations and model/operator limits. receiving_destination_verified uses route distance, shelter accessibility/capacity or clinical destination, not merely shelter_distance_m.
input_schema_notes.external_checks: Caller must verify timestamps, confidence, asset documents and observations. No age tolerance is invented here. These artifacts do not ingest live closure/pump/extent feeds.

depth_bands.label: depth absent, stale or confidence below high

rules.reason: Eligible for human review only when every applicable verification gate is satisfied.
Hazard observations are missing or not current for the dispatch time.
Verify people count before planning extraction or trip capacity.
Incident command must register this actual resource and authorize its assigned mission.
Actual crew and mission-specific training are unverified.
Survey the whole outbound and return route, pickup and receiving point.
Operator has not released the mission against actual weather and equipment limits.
Known weather exceeds the actual resource's operating limits.
Verify working communications, assignment tracking and completion reporting.
Verify fuel or energy reserve, recovery/return and receiving-site support.
Verify mission equipment and personal protection for this resource.
Verify pickup structure, safe access and a usable transfer point.
Validate crew, patient, pet and equipment mass/space plus number of trips; a team needs an assigned conveyance.
Proposed trip exceeds verified passenger, mass, restraint or stability limits.
Night mission requires confirmed trained crew, navigation, lighting and equipment.
Day/night conditions must be known; night equipment is task-specific.
Verify request identity, assigned team and completion state to prevent duplicate visits.
Pump status cannot establish depth or electrical safety; refresh route/depth assessment.
Verify reachable suitable shelter or clinical destination; straight-line nearest-shelter distance is insufficient.
This actual resource is unavailable.
Confirm current availability of the assigned resource; reported fleet totals are not dispatch inventory.
Confirm age, mobility and pet counts; absent case details must not be treated as zero.
Do not enter live or suspected energized floodwater; utility isolation is required.
Power-line status is unverified; outages do not prove the water is de-energized.
Known wires or obstacles obstruct the flight, rotor or hoist corridor.
Survey wire, rotor and hoist clearance; power isolation does not remove wires.
Flight is not authorized or conflicts with rescue aviation.
Obtain coordinated airspace clearance and separation from other rescue aircraft.
Water at or potentially affecting the case plus a road closure excludes road rescue access.
Do not bypass a closed route or barricade, including an otherwise dry approach.
Closure status is unverified or nearby closures need route review.
Unknown, stale or low-confidence depth can never clear a road vehicle as suitable.
Flood footprint date does not establish present route access; require current dated extent and survey.
Generic road vehicle cannot enter floodwater; use verified dry staging and transfer.
Flood operation requires a verified specialist truck configuration and site plan; height alone is insufficient.
Surveyed route exceeds this truck's actual fording or stability margin.
Verify loaded whole-route depth, intact road and model-specific fording margin.
Road vehicles may not enter moving floodwater under this conservative policy.
Current is unknown; obtain competent local flow and control assessment.
Generic volunteer/paddle craft lacks a verified strong-current rescue package.
Known strong current exceeds this resource's confirmed capability.
Strong-current rescue needs a qualified package and site-specific control/recovery plan.
Infants or elderly people in strong current must not use a jet-ski rescue sled.
Debris and submerged obstacles require a site-specific route and recovery review.
Heavy debris can disable/entangle propellers or jet intakes; exclude powered entry on this route.
Loaded hull or propulsion clearance is insufficient on the surveyed route.
Verify loaded minimum route depth, hull draft, drive/intake clearance and margin; point depth is insufficient.
No safe launch, recovery or shore transfer is available.
Verify launch/recovery access, transfer point and backup recovery.
Verify engine-off victim contact and safe propeller stand-off/guarding plan.
Verify the actual rescue sled's retention, patient load and operator rescue training.
Keep victims and crew clear of the air propeller, fan wash and loose objects.
Wheelchair or bedridden case requires an approved secured-litter extraction/transport package.
No confirmed secured litter, loading geometry and clinical transfer package for this patient.
Clinical team must verify packaging, attendants, transfer and wheelchair recovery plan.
Verify age/condition-appropriate restraint, assisted transfer, warmth and monitoring.
Required properly fitting flotation/PPE is unavailable for the proposed occupants.
Verify suitable properly fitting flotation/PPE for every occupant and rescue task.
Confirm pet handling, containment, extra mass/space and safe receiving arrangements.
Road/foot/horse asset cannot directly extract from a roof or upper floor.
Roof/upper-floor water pickup requires verified eaves or window transfer; otherwise request hoist/technical access.
Verify hover/hoist corridor, rescuer access, roof stability, patient rigging and receiving site.
The pickup site cannot safely support the proposed hoist extraction.
Landing-only helicopter needs an accepted load-bearing clear LZ and safe patient path.
Rooftop/upper floor is not a landing zone without an engineered, pilot-accepted elevated LZ and transfer path.
Technician team needs a separately verified conveyance and receiving handoff; it has no intrinsic seats.
Known lack of a safe technical access package prevents elevated extraction.
Confirm appropriate rope/eaves/hoist-assist specialty, anchors and structural access.
Search drone cannot transport people or deliver this case's rescue extraction.
Payload drone provides supplies only and cannot evacuate people.
Confirm fitted thermal sensor and trained interpretation; thermal cannot see through roofs.
No confirmed protected receiving zone and controlled payload delivery method.
Verify payload mass/retention, potable-water packaging or medicine storage/clinical authorization and radio usability.
Untrained volunteer flood-wading is excluded at any depth; use shore support or qualified rescue technicians.
Horse rescue-transport use and safe operating envelope are unverified; do not dispatch as victim conveyance.
Unverified tractor passenger configuration and flood stability are unsafe; historical use is not a capability certification.
No approved passenger seats/compartment for transporting this rescue case.
Confirm location/access type before assigning an extraction method.

NWS.title: During a Flood
NWS.what_it_supports: Public floodwater avoidance; moving water at six inches can knock a person down; hidden road, electrical and debris hazards.

NHTSA.title: Driving in Severe Weather
NHTSA.what_it_supports: Public danger examples: 12 inches rushing water for cars and two feet for most trucks/SUVs; these are not safe operating limits.

FORD.title: Get up and go: Off-Roading
FORD.what_it_supports: Example Ranger fording rating 0.8 m at up to 7 km/h; expressly excludes floodwater/fast-flowing water.
FORD.limitations: Open-page retrieval did not yield the article; indexed manufacturer content inspected.

LR.title: Driving Through Water / Wading Depths
LR.what_it_supports: Model/suspension-specific examples: Defender 0.85-0.90 m, Discovery Sport 0.60 m, Range Rover variants 0.53-0.90 m; not a generic SUV limit.

UNIMOG.title: Unimog U5023 technical data
UNIMOG.what_it_supports: Specific U5023 standard/optional fording depth 0.8/1.2 m; configuration-dependent, not a flood-safety certification.

ELECTRIC.title: What to Do to Protect Yourself From Electrical Hazards
ELECTRIC.what_it_supports: Avoid floodwater with downed lines and overhead electrical hazards; power outage alone does not verify isolation.

OSHA.title: Flood Preparedness and Response: Response/Recovery
OSHA.what_it_supports: Flood response electrical, debris, contamination and responder protection hazards.

PFD.title: Life Jacket Wear
PFD.what_it_supports: Life jackets must fit the wearer, including infant sizes. A child is not an extra uncounted passenger.
PFD.limitations: US guidance is a safety reference, not Brazilian licensing law.

TEAM.title: Swiftwater/Flood Search and Rescue Team, v1.8
TEAM.what_it_supports: Types 1/2/3 have minimum 16/12/6 members; Type 3 includes powered/paddle rescue in current at least one knot; Type 2 adds technical rope and coordination; Type 1 animal specialty; litter and communications equipment.
TEAM.limitations: Typing describes a capability package; one knot is a minimum capability description, not an upper safe current or a local certification.

HELI2017.title: Search and Rescue Aircraft - Helicopter/Rotary Wing
HELI2017.what_it_supports: Historic helicopter mission typing, trained crews and hoist/litter capability for the 2024 context.
HELI2017.limitations: PDF explicitly marked superseded; do not use for current qualification certification.

HELI2025.title: Helicopter/Rotary Wing Search and Rescue Team, v1.4
HELI2025.what_it_supports: Current reference: Type 1 minimum five crew, Type 2 four, Types 3/4 three; Type 4 rescue and at least two transported people including litter provision; Type 2 night/IFR/NVG.
HELI2025.limitations: Postdates RS 2024; reference for present product validation only, not evidence of a 2024 Brazilian unit's qualifications.

NFPA1006.title: NFPA 1006: Technical Rescue Personnel Professional Qualifications
NFPA1006.what_it_supports: Individual technical-rescue job performance qualifications; verify adopted edition and water/rope specialty with authority having jurisdiction.

NFPA2500.title: NFPA 2500: Organizational Capabilities for Technical Search and Rescue
NFPA2500.what_it_supports: Organizational technical rescue capability framework; older NFPA 1670 references need edition checking.
NFPA2500.limitations: Public catalogue only; no claim that clauses were audited or that NFPA is Brazilian law.

CALOES.title: Swiftwater/Flood Search and Rescue SAR Annex
CALOES.what_it_supports: Qualified resources, incident command, safety officer, staging and escalation when capability is exceeded.
CALOES.limitations: Historical operational framework; not a replacement for FEMA's newer typing.

LUND.title: 2024 Lund catalogue: Jon 1448M
LUND.what_it_supports: Flat-bottom aluminium example: four total persons and 825 lb listed capacity; total occupants include crew. No safe flood draft given.

ZODIAC.title: FC-470 rigid floor manufacturer brochure
ZODIAC.what_it_supports: FC-470 example maximum ten total persons and 1250 kg payload; usable arrangement and rescue load still require confirmation.
ZODIAC.limitations: Manufacturer-authored brochure on distributor catalogue host; does not establish actual RS inventory.

YAMAHA.title: WaveRunner owner's manual, page 57
YAMAHA.what_it_supports: Example minimum clearance is 0.60 m below the bottom of the watercraft before running engine, to avoid ingestion/impeller damage. NOT total depth from surface.

AIRBOAT.title: Rescue airboat models and specifications
AIRBOAT.what_it_supports: Manufacturer examples: draft 9-12 inches or 12 inches; six/eight passenger configurations, payload 1200/1500 lb.
AIRBOAT.limitations: Static listed draft, loading basis unspecified; dispatch needs loaded draft plus clearance; passenger versus crew basis must be checked.

SHERP.title: SHERP firefighting UTV presentation
SHERP.what_it_supports: Illustrative amphibious UTV water speed 6 km/h and ground speed 40 km/h; not a CLAnf or generic amphibious rescue speed.

AIRBUS.title: H225M missions
AIRBUS.what_it_supports: Model-specific SAR, night and medevac configurations, up to eleven stretchers plus four attendants; not guaranteed hoist payload or default rescue seating.

DJISEARCH.title: Matrice 350 RTK specifications
DJISEARCH.what_it_supports: Example max wind resistance 12 m/s, max horizontal speed 23 m/s, advertised flight time up to 55 minutes under specified test conditions; thermal sensor must be fitted.

DJIDROP.title: FlyCart 30 specifications
DJIDROP.what_it_supports: Illustrative cargo platform: max horizontal speed 20 m/s, max wind resistance 12 m/s under stated conditions; cargo/winch limits require actual configuration.
DJIDROP.limitations: Maximum test values are not conservative flight release limits. Do not confuse parachute max payload with cargo capacity.

RSSTATE.title: Flood response balance, 19 May, 18h
RSSTATE.what_it_supports: Statewide snapshot: 4061 vehicles, 21 aircraft and 302 boats; vehicle category does not equal high-clearance rescue trucks.

RSCBM.title: CBMRS May floods operational balance
RSCBM.what_it_supports: CBMRS cumulative mobilization: 167 boats, 1064 vehicles; aircraft medical removals and direct rescues. Not simultaneous available inventory.
RSCBM.limitations: Official indexed article inspected; open request timed out.

RSPRF.title: PRF rescue and supplies operations
RSPRF.what_it_supports: Article body: 78 vehicles, four boats and four helicopters, rescue/patrol/supplies; lead and body disagree on boat count.
RSPRF.limitations: Full-page request returned unauthorized; indexed body supports four boats, lead says one; record range one-four, use one for planning, never infer ready fleet.

RSFED.title: 20 mil vidas salvas em trabalhos de resgate
RSFED.what_it_supports: Published joint response figures: at least 30 helicopters, 182 boats, 866 vehicles; separate public-security structure includes one jet ski and two trucks; fuel supply measures.
RSFED.limitations: Search-index verification only; live URL redirects to login and shows later update. Counts are dated reported figures, not certified contemporaneous inventory.

RSNAVY.title: Navy rescues residents in metropolitan Porto Alegre
RSNAVY.what_it_supports: Two aircraft UH-15/UH-12 and six teams; aircraft used where boats/vehicles could not access; boats moved people, pets and supplies.

RSFAB.title: Aviação de Busca e Salvamento operations
RSFAB.what_it_supports: H-60L Black Hawk and H-36 Caracal participated in Taquari II; SAR and evacuation roles.

RSNIGHT.title: FAB daily press digest, 1 May 2024
RSNIGHT.what_it_supports: Reports night hoist rescue supported by night-vision equipment; two H-60 deployed initially.
RSNIGHT.limitations: Press digest, not an independent operational log.

RSARMY.title: Operação Taquari II: novos ensinamentos
RSARMY.what_it_supports: Power, water, communications and supply-logistics failures impeded coordination; satellite communications and volunteers were important.

RSPM.title: Paraná forces support RS with aircraft and boats
RSPM.what_it_supports: Police and firefighters deployed aerial/boat resources for isolated residents; no total national PM fleet inferred.

RSAMPH.title: Novo contingente de Fuzileiros Navais atua na recuperação do RS
RSAMPH.what_it_supports: Later recovery contingent includes CLAnf, eight boats and 65 vehicles around Guaíba, Eldorado and Porto Alegre islands.
RSAMPH.limitations: June recovery evidence, not proof of a particular May passenger rescue or May fleet count.

RSAMPHMAY.title: Atuação da Marinha no desastre ambiental no RS
RSAMPHMAY.what_it_supports: Operational retrospective describes CLAnf arrival and amphibious support in the RS disaster; no generic shallow-water minimum inferred.

RSDRONE.title: Receita helicopter and drones reinforce response
RSDRONE.what_it_supports: Drone and helicopter use for inaccessible areas, assessment and rescue support; report does not enumerate an operational drone fleet.

RSDRONE2.title: Prefeitura intensifica uso de drones
RSDRONE2.what_it_supports: Municipal drone surveillance in inundated areas, integrated security/rescue support; no evidence of person carriage.

DECEA.title: DECEA drone flight safety measures in RS
DECEA.what_it_supports: Flight restriction zone created on 4 May to protect emergency aviation; coordinated authorization required for drones.

RSACCIDENT.title: Polícia de São Paulo encerra missão humanitária no RS
RSACCIDENT.what_it_supports: Reports rescuing volunteers from an overturned boat during early operations; helicopters, drones and boats had complementary roles.
RSACCIDENT.limitations: Open retrieval did not provide readable article; official indexed content inspected.

RSCURRENT.title: Jet skis e barcos são usados para resgate após Guaíba atingir nível recorde
RSCURRENT.what_it_supports: Ilha da Pintada volunteer's hull damaged while rescuing neighbours in Guaíba current; local boats and jet skis used.
RSCURRENT.limitations: Indexed report; full page returned unavailable. No measured current speed or technical accident investigation.

RSDUP.title: Plataforma criada por voluntários centraliza resgates
RSDUP.what_it_supports: Salva RS introduced callback verification, closing completed records and removing duplicate requests because communications and dispersed requests complicated coordination.

RSTRACTOR.title: 15 dias de enchentes: imagens da tragédia
RSTRACTOR.what_it_supports: Photo caption documents tractors used to rescue people in Eldorado do Sul; no passenger safety certification or fleet total.

RSPRIVATE.title: Havan homenageia pilotos que resgataram vítimas no RS
RSPRIVATE.what_it_supports: Company-reported two helicopters for supplies, medicines and rescues; not an audited private-fleet total.

RSOMNI.title: Omni Taxi Aereo Responds to the Floods in Rio Grande do Sul
RSOMNI.what_it_supports: Private operator directly reports rescue, transport of supplies and support reaching inaccessible areas; not a census of private aviation.

RSAVEX.title: AvEx envia seis helicopteros para apoio as enchentes
RSAVEX.what_it_supports: Secondary deployment report identifies six Army helicopters sent to support operations, not simultaneous mission-ready inventory.
RSAVEX.limitations: Secondary historical report; not used as a technical capability authority.

RSHORSE.title: Cavalos resgatados foram adotados ou devolvidos
RSHORSE.what_it_supports: Horses were flood victims and sheltered animals. Does not establish horses used as rescue transport.

HARVEY.title: Hurricane Harvey After Action Review: actions supplement
HARVEY.what_it_supports: Explicit follow-up actions for boat operator training, resource ordering, staging notifications, logistics caches and staff roles.

HELENE.title: Hurricane Helene aviation after-action workshop
HELENE.what_it_supports: Aircraft fuel management, airport coordination, power/communications and controlled takeoffs/landings are aviation readiness requirements.

GERMANY.title: BBK spontaneous-volunteer integration projects
GERMANY.what_it_supports: HoWas2021 studied integration of responders and spontaneous volunteers after July 2021 floods; supports registration/assignment gate, not asset depth limits.
GERMANY.limitations: Indexed official content inspected; live request returned forbidden.

PAKISTAN.title: Post-monsoon 2022 review conference
PAKISTAN.what_it_supports: Confirms a multi-agency lessons review; no usable asset-specific operating limit in public summary. No new dispatch threshold imported.

POLICY.title: BRIEF_FLEET.md and conservative research policy
POLICY.what_it_supports: Requested depth bands, wheelchair/bedridden stretcher rule, infant/elderly strong-current sled exclusion, and explicitly labelled conservative defaults. These are design decisions, not sourced engineering safe limits.
POLICY.limitations: Not external evidence; associated rules also cite the hazard/capability sources motivating them.
